items.title: Apple hit with a $5.7 billion verdict for alleged patent infringement

items.lede: Haptics tech company Taction sued Apple in 2021, alleging it infringed two of its patents. Now a federal jury in San Diego has awarded Taction over $5.7 billion in damages. items.title: Apple hit with $5.7 billion in damages over haptic patents

items.lede: Audio firm Taction Technology claimed Apple infringed its patents for tech used to power device vibrations.
